metadata.question: In 2004, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Death Valley, USA record the highest maximum daytime land surface temperature in the world?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra MOD11A2 (8-day, 1 km) daytime LST (LST_Day_1km) for 2004 globally; if empty, fallback to Aqua MYD11A2. Compare the global maximum to the maximum within a Death Valley polygon.
2. Masking strategy: Apply QC_Day bits 0–1 <= 1 (good/acceptable) and remove zeros. Not a cloud question; proper QC masking ensures valid LST.
3. Logic: 
   - If collection empty after initial search and fallback: C1.
   - If Death Valley has zero valid pixels after masking: C2.
   - If computed values are null/NaN or outside plausible range (-50 to 100 C): C3.
   - Else compare DV max to global max; if equal and global max location lies in DV: A, otherwise B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  }
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2004-01-01';
    const end = '2004-12-31';
    // Death Valley polygon (approximate valley floor and surroundings)
    const dvGeom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [
        [-117.6, 35.5],
        [-116.25, 35.5],
        [-116.25, 37.5],
        [-117.6, 37.5],
        [-117.6, 35.5]
      ]
    ]);
    const world = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-180, -60, 180, 80], geodesic: false});

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let product = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2'; // Terra
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(product)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      // Fallback to Aqua
      product = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A2';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(product)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log(`2004 Images (${product}): 0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing: QC mask and composites
    function maskMOD11A2(img) {
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      const good01 = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // bits 0-1 <= 1
      const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km');
      return lst.updateMask(good01).updateMask(lst.neq(0));
    }
    const colMasked = col.map(maskMOD11A2); // single band LST_Day_1km masked
    const imgCount = await getInfoAsync(colMasked.size());

    // Valid-pixel map (any valid observation in 2004)
    const validAny = colMasked.map(function(img) {
      return img.unmask(0).gt(0).rename('valid'); // 1 where valid
    }).max().rename('valid');

    // Per-pixel maximum (raw, scaled by 0.02 K)
    const maxRaw = colMasked.max().rename('LSTmax');

    // 4. Pixel count checks
    const dvValid = await getInfoAsync(
      maxRaw.updateMask(validAny).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: dvGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('LSTmax')
    );
    if (!dvValid || dvValid === 0) {
      console.log(`2004 Images (${product.split('/').pop()}): ${imgCount}`);
      console.log('Death Valley valid pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation: Global and DV maxima (raw units)
    const globalMaxRaw = await getInfoAsync(
      maxRaw.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: world,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('LSTmax')
    );
    const dvMaxRaw = await getInfoAsync(
      maxRaw.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: dvGeom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('LSTmax')
    );

    function toC(valRaw) {
      return valRaw * 0.02 - 273.15;
    }
    const gC = globalMaxRaw != null ? toC(globalMaxRaw) : null;
    const dvC = dvMaxRaw != null ? toC(dvMaxRaw) : null;

    // 6. Validation for C3
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || Number.isNaN(v) || v < -50 || v > 100);
    if (invalid(gC) || invalid(dvC)) {
      console.log(`2004 Images (${product.split('/').pop()}): ${imgCount}`);
      console.log(`Death Valley valid pixels: ${dvValid}`);
      console.log(`Death Valley Max LST (°C): ${dvC}`);
      console.log(`Global Max LST (°C): ${gC}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 7. Global max location and containment check
    const eqMask = maxRaw.eq(ee.Image.constant(globalMaxRaw)).selfMask();
    const lonlat = ee.Image.pixelLonLat().updateMask(eqMask);
    const sampleFC = lonlat.sample({
      region: world,
      scale: 1000,
      numPixels: 1,
      geometries: true
    });
    const sample = await getInfoAsync(sampleFC.first());
    let glon = null, glat = null, inDV = false;
    if (sample && sample.geometry) {
      const coords = sample.geometry.coordinates;
      glon = coords[0];
      glat = coords[1];
      inDV = await getInfoAsync(dvGeom.contains(ee.Geometry.Point([glon, glat])));
    } else {
      // Fallback: test if any equality pixel intersects DV
      const anyDV = await getInfoAsync(
        eqMask.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: dvGeom,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('longitude') // not present; instead use a constant band
      );
      inDV = (anyDV && anyDV > 0) ? true : false;
    }

    // 8. Output concise evidence
    console.log(`2004 Images (${product.split('/').pop()}): ${imgCount}`);
    console.log(`Death Valley valid pixels: ${dvValid}`);
    console.log(`Death Valley Max LST (°C): ${dvC.toFixed(2)}`);
    const locStr = (glon !== null && glat !== null) ? `@(${glat.toFixed(3)}, ${glon.toFixed(3)})` : '@(n/a)';
    console.log(`Global Max LST (°C): ${gC.toFixed(2)} ${locStr}`);
    console.log(`DV equals Global Max: ${dvMaxRaw === globalMaxRaw}`);
    console.log(`Global max in DV: ${inDV}`);

    // 9. Final Answer
    if (dvMaxRaw === globalMaxRaw && inDV) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
